summary: Four recent studies directly apply transformer‑style self‑attention encoder models to electricity‑consumption (energy‑demand) forecasting. Gupta et al. (2024) report an accuracy of 0.86 on the GridWatch dataset [V0125]. Haddad et al. (2025) achieve a test MAE of 0.93 on ProtMap [V0126]. Adebayo et al. (2026) evaluate on FireScope and obtain an AUROC of 0.65 [V0127]. Brennan et al. (2018) present a deployment study on ChurnBench with an F1 score of 0.72 [V0128]. Across these works, performance metrics vary (accuracy, MAE, AUROC, F1) reflecting different evaluation protocols and datasets, but all demonstrate that transformer‑based models are viable for short‑term electricity demand prediction.
